notes.title: 【小型更新】2月1日 添加了日语补丁！
notes.notes:
感谢社区玩家的帮助，我们日语版本上线啦！
在此感谢franktk大佬帮我们进行了日文版翻译，以及 Horai大佬的英文版润色！


以下为本次的更新内容！

1、多语言增加日语补丁
2、修复部分多语言适配bug
3、优化部分英语翻译

notes.title: [Patch Update 0117] Monster&weapon&Puzzle Bug fixes + Optimization
notes.notes:
[u][b]Bug fixes
[/b][/u]

1. Fixed the problem where the crystal held by the monster cannot be picked up in the scene
2. Fixed the problem that some scenes are not visible
3. Fixed the problem that some puzzles cannot be operated after they are collected (Reloading game required)
4. Fixed the shotgun UI display bug
5. Fixed the problem that the shotgun cannot be equipped in a mount position other than the first
6. You can now adjust the Music and Sound
7. Deleted an incombustible painting in the scene
8. Fixed the problem where the cabinet on the second floor might break due to reading files
9. Fixed the problem that the Echoing Corridor wall issue
10. Fixed the abnormal positions of a few operation prompts display
11. Fixed the UI bug while reading letters
12. Fixed the problem for which the game might start with Steam VR 
13. Press T to remove the magazine from the pistol, the magazine will be placed in the backpack instead of dropping on the floor unless the backpack is full.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39168937/4d9497015fc1e6cbaeb1667bf00bd9b331b5ab13.gif[/img]


[u][b]Optimization
[/b][/u]

1. Optimized the performance of the dissolving special effects
2. Optimize the effect of the flash bomb, which can cancel the Boss's tornado
3. Optimize the lighting of the Easter egg scene
4. Optimize multi-language
5. Optimized interface guidelines
6. Accessories can now be removed one at a time, optimized the automatic synthesis operation
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39168937/37e789700a89c4f307e6d3017362ab3a863af72d.gif[/img]
7. The magazines in the plate can be directly selected and synthesized, bullets can be unloaded one at a time
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39168937/0927aac9ef577df6e64cd876f243d07347a6e8c7.gif[/img]

notes.title: [Patch Update 0116] Bug fixes & Optimization
notes.notes:
[u]1月16日	BUG Fixes


[/u]	

1.Press T to remove the magazine from the pistol, the magazine will be placed in the backpack instead of dropping on the floor, unless backpack is full.
	
2. Fixed the problem that the switch cover may not be opened, resulting in the inability to operate the knob.
	
3.Fixed the problem that pressing ESC cannot exit when interacting with the safe.	

4.Fixed the problem that the last piece of the puzzle was not displayed	

5.Fixed the bug where some player cannot trigger the boss battle.
	
6. Fix the bug where the abnormal body might push the player into the wall and gets stuck

7. Fix the issue where the shotgun may drop after reading the file

8. Fix the bug when the abnormal body might immediately attack the player after getting up

9. Fix the bug where the player can entre the portal from the back and get stuck.

10. Removed an extra G cup in the first level

11. Melee/throwing/explosion damage can now break the G cup
	
	
	
[b]	Optimization
[/b]	
1. Weakened the HP point of the soldier monster and added more supply in the area.
2. Increased the number of white crystals.
3. Some items/items that have been picked up will no longer trigger the pickup animation.
4. Optimized the melee attack effect, improved the damage and stiff effect.
5. The magazines and bullets removed by pressing T will now go directly into the backpack instead of falling to the ground.
6. Some items will not collide with the character after falling.
7. Modified the names of some weapons.

notes.title: Welcome to Project Morpheus: Prologue! 【Info + Q&A】
notes.notes:
HI there! Welcome and thank you for playing Project Morpheus: Prologue, we are TeamRanger, a 2-man game dev team.ːsteamhappyː

This prologue is a pre-experience version of the full game. 
The game development process has been quite a challenge for us, therefore there will be bugs that we haven't caught, or problems we don't yet know. But we are full of passion to keep improving and polishing the game. We thank you for your support and understanding!


Below is a list of problems we collected from our players and will be updated regularly, 
if you have any questions regarding the game, please please feel free to check out the Q&A section below on this post!

Also please do let us know if you have encountered any other bugs and problems, 
simply post on the Steam Community, or contact us via [url=https://twitter.com/home]Twitter[/url], 
We will get back to you & work on these bugs ASAP!

We look forward to hearing your thoughts! Cheers!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39168937/1c54c013eee14d29e3b742ef113170c18b5fbe35.gif[/img]

----------  Q&A Section ----------


[b]If the game build prompts VS2019[/b]
Please run [u]VC_redist.x64.exe[/u] in the /RuntimeTools folder under the game installation directory
Or download from the official website: : https://support.microsoft.com/zh-cn/help/2977003/the-latest-supported-visual-c-downloads 

[b]If the game prompts an exception related to Directx[/b]
Please update the graphics card driver and the windows 10 operating system to the latest
